# `expect` is an ERE matched against the LAST non-empty line of the command's
# combined stdout+stderr; the exit code must equal the fifth column. Both must
# hold. Rows are reviewed, committed, and refused (POLICY, exit 2) if they are
# not a single simple command (allowlisted first token, no metacharacters, no

column6: the scorecard audit's own verdict (round 13), run here through the ledger's claims machinery: every Round pre/post cell points at a resolving row or a fresh pinned artifact. This is the ONE self-referential row that is safe — the cell audit skips rows whose command re-invokes this gate (`SKIP-SELF`), so it does not recurse; a row running `verify` would, and `verify` refuses a nested self-audit (exit 2), which is why the `verify` summary itself is unpinnable and is quoted by the round report instead
